name.description: This is the name of the squad.

members.description:
This is the list of assistants that make up the squad.

The call will start with the first assistant in the list.

membersOverrides.description:
This can be used to override all the assistants' settings and provide values for their template variables.

Both `membersOverrides` and `members[n].assistantOverrides` can be used together. First, `members[n].assistantOverrides` is applied. Then, `membersOverrides` is applied as a global override.

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the squad.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the org that this squad belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the squad was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the squad was last updated.
